new_finding.title: Message-specific InMemory Add and Insert omit the selected explicit operation token from the configured saga factory context

actual_original_contexts.first_failure: Source789 Assert.True(factory.ObservedToken.IsCancellationRequested): actualFalse after operationCancellation.Cancel; consume token intentionally remains live.
reached: Actual Add/Insert initial or reacquired dictionary-lease branch admits factory once; exact dictionary/state/mode/message/Advanced.ReceiveContext identity and distinct caller/consume tokens checked.
Factory task/public operation/Continue are held, dictionary empty and factory token initially live; explicit operation token canceled while consume token remains live before first789.
unreached: Post-finally dictionary/saga availability assertions; original assertion rethrows after finally.
actual_original_contexts.source_cause: Add and Insert select explicit operation token for precancel/dictionary acquisition, then pass original _context into factory in both initial and reacquired lease routes. Actual factory awaits context.CancellationToken, so caller cancellation never reaches its held wait. Load has OperationConsumeContext and remains unchanged.
actual_original_contexts.healthy_control: Four same mode/lease cases with cancelCallerfalse pass manual release and exact created context/state/message/ReceiveContext, dictionary registration, terminal success and lease checks.
actual_original_contexts.cleanup: Finally releases Continue then joins actual factory Task and public operation with timeout exclusion; disposes created/seed context and repository, releases any caller-owned dictionary lease. No post-finally assertion credit for failed cases.
actual_original_contexts.family_precision: Four original cases establish one coherent Add/Insert explicit-token forwarding omission, no automatic ID or SagaInstance defect.
